title: What If Every Sea Turtle Vanished?
subject: sea turtle

scenes.text: What if every sea turtle vanished? The ocean's grass and its beaches would feel it first.
Green turtles graze seagrass like a lawn, which keeps the blades healthy and full of nutrients.
Without that grazing, the nitrogen supply to seagrass roots can drop by a factor of fifteen.
Leatherbacks, up to nine feet long, can eat hundreds of pounds of jellyfish a day.
Hawksbills eat sponges that would otherwise crowd out coral on the reef.
And on land, buried eggs feed the dune plants whose roots hold the beach together.
